sources.snippet: Granite-4.0-350M Model Summary: Granite-4.0-350M is a lightweight instruct model finetuned from Granite-4.0-350M-Base using a combination of open source instruction datasets with permissive license and internally collected synthetic datasets. This model is developed using a diverse set of techniques including supervised finetuning, reinforcement learning, and model merging.
